in_hebrew.name: Haroldson
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Rule Hari's son
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Haroldson הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old Norse elements har (ruler) and wald (rule) + son. This name is of Old Norse origin and is traditionally given to boys. It is a name of royal lineage, meaning 'rule Hari's son'.
